_meta.name: MAKE49 pre-registered experiment configuration
_meta.status: pre-registered; do not edit after results are seen (log changes in 変更履歴 §9)

loss_convention.note: KL sums over latent dims. Fixes audit finding A1 where KL used torch.mean, giving beta_eff = beta/m.
loss_convention.regression_test: KL must scale linearly with m for fixed per-coordinate statistics

beta.selection_rule: pre-declared; NOT chosen by observing AU behaviour
beta.legacy_mapping: old beta=4 corresponds to beta_eff=4/m, i.e. 0.0625..1.0 over m in [4,64]

feasibility_check_2026_09_12.protocol: 60 epochs, seed 42, no early stopping; betas 0.05,0.1 added below the registered ladder purely to bound the range
feasibility_check_2026_09_12.CIFAR10: usable across the whole registered ladder; AU falls monotonically 64->17 as beta rises 0.25->4
feasibility_check_2026_09_12.dSprites: COLLAPSES AT EVERY BETA TESTED (0.05..4.0): AU=0, KL=0.000, val SSE ~173.52 vs 173.74 for an all-zero prediction
feasibility_check_2026_09_12.conclusion: beta is not the cause of the dSprites failure; see likelihood diagnostic
feasibility_check_2026_09_12.note: this was a feasibility check of the registered ladder, NOT a re-selection of beta

quality_criterion_Q.anchor_training: same model family, likelihood, beta and training settings as candidates; cost is charged
quality_criterion_Q.T_D: D_anchor + epsilon_D; fixed before any intervention; never recomputed after beta tuning or capacity expansion
quality_criterion_Q.decision: smallest EVALUATED m with D_val(m) <= T_D

dev_condition_precomputation_pre_A1_fix.dataset: MNIST FC-VAE, 3 seeds, 300 epochs, anchor m=64
dev_condition_precomputation_pre_A1_fix.note: Pre-registered prediction on pre-fix data. Do NOT loosen epsilon_D if this occurs. Recompute after the A1 fix.

au.definition: count of latent coords j with Var_x(mu_j) > delta
au.synthetic_data: standardize data before training; delta defined on standardized latent variance (audit finding A4)

method_2_predictive.unit: one checkpoint = (dataset, architecture, m, seed, best_epoch)
method_2_predictive.target_Y: does the model trained at the next smaller grid point m_minus satisfy Q (binary)
method_2_predictive.predictor: logistic regression (L2); regularisation strength selected on development-condition validation only, then frozen
method_2_predictive.decision_rule: seed-level bootstrap (2000 reps) 95% CI of mean delta_auroc over held-out conditions; AU has incremental value ONLY if the lower bound exceeds 0; otherwise move AU to auxiliary analysis

method_1_intervention.reason: requires extra training budget; beta intervention confounded by the A1 fix

known_issue_nonmonotone_in_beta.observation: dSprites + Bernoulli, m=16: AU goes 16,16,14,12,16 as beta goes 0.25,0.5,1,2,4 while KL falls monotonically and SSE rises monotonically
known_issue_nonmonotone_in_beta.suspected_cause: AU uses an ABSOLUTE threshold Var_x(mu_j) > delta; larger beta shrinks the scale of mu, so the verdict tracks scale rather than informativeness
known_issue_nonmonotone_in_beta.related: stage-1 audit finding A4 (delta is scale dependent)
known_issue_nonmonotone_in_beta.action: must be addressed in E4 (delta sensitivity); prepare a scale-normalised AU definition as a control

E7a.rationale_for_5: longest of the 1/2/5 settings FONDUE Appendix G used for FONDUE-VAR; most favourable early point for the original method
E7a.primary_statistic: between-seed SD at matched m and matched readout
E7a.decision_rule: seed-level bootstrap (2000 reps) 95% CI of SD(300)/SD(5); H1 supported only if the upper bound is below 1
E7a.degenerate_handling: AU==0 or AU==m conditions have small SD by construction; report raw values and exclude such conditions from H1 support
forbidden: ranking raw SD of readouts A/B/C in a single column

A_variable_type.rationale: AU counts non-collapsed units; passive is the collapsed class, so m - passive matches AU's estimand
A_variable_type.check: active + mixed + passive == m must hold in every condition

C_fondue_ide.note: continuous; separate panel from A and B

representative_trial_2026_09_12.design: 2 datasets x 3 capacities x 5 seeds, 300 epochs, no early stopping, beta=1
representative_trial_2026_09_12.H1: supported for readouts A and B on MNIST at the larger capacities; readout C reverses at MNIST m=64 (CI [2.17,7.45]); dSprites undetermined (SD=0 at 5 epochs)
representative_trial_2026_09_12.H2: NOT SUPPORTED in any condition. A and B converge to nearly identical values by 300 epochs; at 5 epochs on MNIST m=64 readout A is the more stable one (SD 3.83 vs 8.08), the opposite of H2
representative_trial_2026_09_12.plateau: 0 of 30 runs reached the pre-registered plateau criterion; 300 epochs must not be called convergence
representative_trial_2026_09_12.au_vs_m: MNIST AU = 6.4, 6.0, 6.4 for m = 12, 32, 64 (flat); confirms stage-1 finding A2 under the corrected loss with 5 seeds
representative_trial_2026_09_12.v2_coefficients: AU/d_ID is 0.43-0.46 on MNIST and 1.76-1.89 on dSprites; the manuscript's V2 lower-bound invariant range (0.70, 1.0] fails on both sides
representative_trial_2026_09_12.consequence: the AU claim must rest solely on the method-2 predictive evaluation (settings table 1.1); 'AU is more stable' is not available as an argument

fondue_reimplementation.implementation_basis: paper text specification, PyTorch; NOT called a faithful reproduction of the original code

B6a_algorithm1.threshold_primary: 20% rule: 0.2 * initial data ID estimate, used as an ABSOLUTE threshold, fixed across the search
B6a_algorithm1.epochs: per-dataset settings reported in the FONDUE paper; NOT unified to the code default of 1 epoch

pseudocode_confirmed.body: l<-0; u<-inf; p<-IDE_data; threshold<-t*p/100 computed ONCE; while p!=l: if IDE_z-IDE_mu<=threshold: l<-p; p<-min(2p,u) else: u<-p; p<-floor((l+u)/2); return p
pseudocode_confirmed.threshold_note: the paper's text says t=0.2 meaning 20% of the data IDE; the pseudocode writes t*p/100 which needs t=20 for the same value. We use 0.2*IDE_data, matching the text (U13).
pseudocode_confirmed.threshold_fixed: computed once from the initial data IDE and NOT updated as p changes
pseudocode_confirmed.epochs_rule_for_new_datasets: the paper increases epochs until the prediction stops changing; apply the same procedure for MNIST

B6b_algorithm3_fondue_var.variance_handling_primary: single exponentiation (generate sigma^2 once, classify per definition)
B6b_algorithm3_fondue_var.variance_handling_auxiliary: fixed-commit code path with double exponentiation; representative conditions only
B6b_algorithm3_fondue_var.keep_mixed_implementation: independent boolean argument; do NOT use the original cfg.threshold is True/False branch
B6b_algorithm3_fondue_var.claim_limit: this is a pre-registered reimplementation choice, NOT a claim about which branch Table 7 used; record as 未確認

pseudocode_confirmed.body: l<-2*data_ide; n<--1; while n<0: train VAE(dim=l, epochs); av,mv,pv<-variable_types; if pv>0 and keep_mixed: n<-av+mv; elif (mv>0 or pv>0) and not keep_mixed: n<-av; else: l<-2l; return n
pseudocode_confirmed.confirms: keep_mixed=True returns av+mv, consistent with the pre-registered H2 estimand

reporting_partition.b: fixed-commit code path -> reproducibility audit only
reporting_partition.c: published Table 7 values -> historical reference column only

forbidden: judging validity solely by matching dSprites 12.2 +/- 0.4
claiming Table 7 or the original early-training conclusions are wrong based on the double-exponentiation finding

budget_and_termination.checkpoint_selection: best validation monitor value; test never used
budget_and_termination.plateau_criterion: relative change of the validation monitor over the last 50 epochs < 1%; otherwise record 未 plateau
budget_and_termination.aggregation_rule: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED trials must NOT be silently dropped from success rates or mean selected m; always report the breakdown of termination states

early_stopping_scope.reason: E7a compares readouts along a fixed trajectory; early stopping would remove the 300-epoch checkpoint required by the 5-vs-300 primary comparison
early_stopping_scope.e7a_rule: always run the full 300 epochs; record the plateau verdict but do not stop on it

budget_and_termination.max_wallclock_basis: 12 training runs x 300 epochs (no early stop) x 1.25 overhead; measured 2026-09-12, see results/make49/stage3_budget.json

max_training_runs_counting_rule.counts: candidate VAE trainings only (the model family being selected over), including the anchor and re-search
max_training_runs_counting_rule.does_not_count: reference AE trainings and linear probes; these are charged to wall-clock only
max_training_runs_counting_rule.reason: 9 reference AEs (3 m_ref x 3 seeds) would occupy 9 of the 12 runs, leaving 3 for candidates; the wall-clock limit in section 8.2 was derived from 12 CANDIDATE trainings at 300 epochs

degenerate_selection.meaning: the method returned a latent dimension that cannot be trained (m < 1)
degenerate_selection.observed: FONDUE-VAR Algorithm 3 with keep_mixed=False returns n=av, and av=0 on MNIST at 1 epoch (no variable meets the strict active criterion: between-data variance < 0.1 AND mean <= 0.1)
degenerate_selection.faithful: this is the original algorithm's behaviour, not an implementation error; Appendix G itself notes that mixed and passive variables are not discriminated correctly in early epochs
degenerate_selection.handling: record the state, skip final training, do NOT drop the trial from the termination-state breakdown

data_splits.subset_sampling: fixed random draw with saved indices; NOT data[:n] head order
data_splits.test_usage: final evaluation only; never used for selection, thresholds or checkpoint choice
data_splits.statistical_units: training seed / data split / ID subsampling repeats are NOT pooled to inflate n
data_splits.seed_counting: re-evaluating one checkpoint 5 times does NOT count as 5 seeds; the full pipeline from reference model to selection is repeated

subset_sizes._note: added 2026-09-12 during stage-3 calibration; logged in 実験設定表 §9

dSprites.note: no official split; two disjoint ranges of one fixed permutation of 737280

metrics_convention.reconstruction_mse: per-pixel mean (reduction='mean') everywhere; recompute legacy sum-form tables (audit finding A6)
metrics_convention.elbo: plain ELBO (beta=1) always reported alongside the beta-weighted objective
metrics_convention.train_mse: computed in eval mode with the same reconstruction path as validation
metrics_convention.downstream: fixed linear probe test accuracy; probe regularisation chosen on validation

candidate_grids.note: all methods use the same grid so the comparison denominator matches

initial_window.vae_initial_diagnostic_point: first grid point >= 2*d_ID; NOT treated as an optimum
initial_window.justification_limit: c=2 is a default under test, motivated by the known embedding upper bound; NOT derived from a theorem

estimation_sample.changed: 2026-09-12: was 'validation'; validation holds only 2000 points so n=10000 was unsatisfiable. ID estimation is a fitting step, consistent with 'fit transforms on train only'. Logged in 実験設定表 §9.

id_stability_criterion.metric: (max - min) / median of d_ID across the three m_ref

reference_and_id.on_failure: return ID_UNRELIABLE and switch to the pre-declared conventional validation search (B4); charge all fallback cost and label the result a fallback

costa_hero_mst.reason: E7, direct comparison and reference-dependence come first (方針 §5.5 E3)

criterion_applies_to.input_space_estimate_used_for: sizing m_ref only; NOT for the ID_UNRELIABLE decision
criterion_applies_to.reason: stage-3 calibration found TwoNN and MLE disagree strongly on raw dSprites and CIFAR-10 pixels; the spec did not say which representation the criterion applies to

m_ref_rule.rounding: round(k*d0); NOT snapped to the candidate grid
m_ref_rule.changed: 2026-09-13: was snapped to the candidate grid, which collapsed all three m_ref to the grid max on MNIST and made the ID-stability check vacuous. Logged in 実験設定表 §9.

provenance_recording.requirements_freeze: pip freeze > requirements_freeze.txt, shipped in supplementary
provenance_recording.reason: audit finding A5: CUDA/cuDNN/driver were never recorded and the ENVIRONMENT.md TODO is unprocessed

cost_accounting.fairness_rule: every method is charged up to the point where a selected model is ready for final evaluation

likelihood._note: added 2026-09-12 after stage-3 calibration found dSprites collapses under Gaussian at every beta; logged in 実験設定表 §9
rules: state the likelihood in every table and figure
never rank loss values across datasets with different likelihoods
beta means different things under different likelihoods; do not call the same beta the same strength across likelihoods
the per-pixel mean MSE evaluation metric is common to all likelihoods; Q is judged on it
within one dataset every comparison method uses the same likelihood
